catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class triggers an oscilloscope: cap.device.configure.v1 is the state-write class and the sensing/read classes bind sensor resource kinds only, so the force-trigger command is an extension.

notes:
Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0): evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wB1-031) and unreviewed; nothing ran on hardware and no hardware run is claimed. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver over tekinstr.mdo3000.oscilloscope:Oscilloscope with native.py, not the card's ScpiDriver; the upstream is an object with properties and its channel commands are assembled from parts (CH{ch}:...), so a command table would cover only the fixed timebase commands. NOT COVERED: the waveform array (Oscilloscope.read returns WaveformDT or a numpy array at tekinstr/oscilloscope.py:240-325; no catalogue class carries a trace array) and the per-channel vertical settings, probe and trigger configuration. The fake is an in-memory stand-in for the Oscilloscope object, not the clone's pyvisa-sim test file (tests/test_sim/sim_hw.yml is a transport simulator for the upstream suite); its numbers are placeholders and are not facts. The horizontal scale has no range in the clone, so it is Limit.operator_required and site-limits.example.json shows an example narrowing. The upstream Oscilloscope has no close method, so native.py keeps the open CommChannel and closes it at interpreter exit; a long-running endpoint holds the VISA session open. The num_averages allowed set is every power of two from the docstring range 2 to 512 because the docstring does not list the individual values. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
